headline: Casa Para Ver La Peña / Tenter Studio
context: From the street, the house appears restrained and silent. The stone volumes are barely pronounced, avoiding any emphatic gesture. The architecture does not seek to announce itself; it holds back. It is only upon crossing the property line that the project begins to reveal itself.
